Finite invalid ranges/infinities rejected unless NaN obscures another constraint. Scaling uses cached original start+factor*(end-start) for both endpoints. No validation of source duration/finite scaled times. Normalclose only/no finally. Ordinal helper specialcases1/2/3, allother th. No archived execution or approval prompt issued by this audit. Creates TreeTrunk explicitly INCRE_STARTTIME, init root; null root prints contains no drawables, closes+exit0. This conflates legitimate null pointer and InputLog.readTreeNode IO/size failure returningnull with empty content; prior IOError may be visible but finalsuccess remains. Nonnullroot copies bounds/scales, printswindowstderr, growsTreeWindow(root,requestedshortdepth,window). Negative depth can descendpast leaf and dereference null childarray; depth>=rootdepth stops growth, updateLowestDepth choosesloadedroot. Node mode TreeTrunk.toString prints stubs+wholeloadednode contents, including objects outside requested timewindow because window controls node loading. Time mode TreeTrunk.toString(window) executes separate increasingSTART real nestable/nestless passes then shadows fromlowestfloor; help says within endtimes but implementation uses earlier documented overlap iterators and hardcoded STARTorder, not InputLog whole-directory endpoint queue. No globalordering/count/integrity test or equivalence assertion between modes. Printed metadata unconditional via InputLog.toString. No prune call in this path.
